title: Complementary filter angle fuse
prompt: Implement `comp_filter(angle, gyro_rate, accel_angle, dt, alpha=0.98)` returning updated angle: alpha*(angle+gyro_rate*dt)+(1-alpha)*accel_angle.
public_tests_hint:
- alpha=1 → pure integrate
- alpha=0 → accel only
test_source:
import solution

def run():
    assert abs(solution.comp_filter(0,10,5,0.1,1.0)-1.0)<1e-12
    assert abs(solution.comp_filter(0,10,5,0.1,0.0)-5.0)<1e-12
    v=solution.comp_filter(0,0,10,0.1,0.98)
    assert abs(v-0.2)<1e-12
